info.title: Altinn Management REST API
info.description: Manages Kartverket's resources in Altinn's Resource Registry.

get.description: Gets Kartverket's resources of type `MaskinportenSchema` from Altinn, or with `scope`, only the ones that give that Maskinporten scope. When filtering is on, this API only returns the ones the calling app has access to: the resource, and every one of its scopes, must be in the app's `exact` list or start with one of its prefixes. This holds with `scope` too, so a resource that also gives a scope the app may not see is left out. This API reads which app is calling from the `X-Forwarded-Client-Cert` header, which Istio usually sets. Altinn's search returns the newest version of each resource that matches, so if a resource's type or owner has changed, the list can hold an older version of it. Get a resource by its id to be sure you have its current version.

parameters.name: scope
parameters.description: Only the resources that give this Maskinporten scope, for example `kartverk:matrikkel:brukernavn`. It must match exactly, case included. Send one scope, at most once.

parameters.name: X-Forwarded-Client-Cert
parameters.description: Says which app is calling. Istio usually sets it on every call, so the app does not. This API requires it when filtering is on.

parameters.name: X-Request-ID
parameters.description: An id to find this call by in this API's logs. Up to 128 ASCII letters, digits, `-`, `_`, `.` and `:`. Without it, or with any other value, this API makes a new one. Every response has the id in its `X-Request-Id` header.

200.description: Kartverket's MaskinportenSchemas, only those that give `scope` when it is sent, and when filtering is on, only those the calling app has access to. The list is empty if there are none.

X-Request-ID.description: The id of this call in this API's logs: the `X-Request-Id` you sent, or a new one.

put.description: Replaces the MaskinportenSchema with this id in Altinn with the one in the body. Send it whole: a field that is left out is removed. What Altinn has that this API does not show, such as the owner, is kept as it is, and so are `status`, `delegable` and `visible`. Only Kartverket's resources of type `MaskinportenSchema` can be changed: any other resource gives `404`, as if it did not exist.

MaskinportenSchema.title: MaskinportenSchema
MaskinportenSchema.description: A resource of type `MaskinportenSchema` in Altinn, with the values Altinn has. A field Altinn has no value for is left out. `title` is its name, `description` says what it gives access to, and `delegationDescription` explains the rights an organisation gets when the resource is delegated to it.

resourceId.description: The resource's id in Altinn: 4 or more of `a-z`, `0-9`, `_` and `-`. It cannot be changed.

scopes.description: The Maskinporten scopes the resource is for. An organisation the resource is delegated to in Altinn can get tokens with these scopes on behalf of the organisation that delegated it.

homepage.description: A web page about the resource.

contactPoints.description: Where to get help with the resource. Can be empty.

keywords.description: Words to find the resource by in Altinn. Can be empty.

status.description: Altinn's status for the resource, such as `Completed`, `Active`, `UnderDevelopment`, `Deprecated` or `Withdrawn`.

delegable.description: If `true`, organisations can delegate the resource to others in Altinn.

visible.description: If `true`, Altinn shows the resource to its users.

field.description: The query parameter, path parameter, header or body field.

code.description:
- `MISSING`: the field is absent or blank.
- `INVALID_FORMAT`: the field is there, but not valid.

message.description: What is wrong, for people to read. The wording may change.

type.description:
What went wrong, as a name that does not change, so your code can rely on it.

- `tag:kartverket.no,2026:validation-error` (400): one or more fields are missing or invalid. `errors` lists all of
  them.
- `tag:kartverket.no,2026:malformed-request` (400): the request could not be read, for example a body that is not
  valid JSON, a field with the wrong type, or a `Content-Type` that is not `application/json`.
- `tag:kartverket.no,2026:upstream-rejected` (400): the values passed this API's checks, but Altinn rejected them.
- `tag:kartverket.no,2026:not-found` (404): there is nothing at this path: no endpoint, or no MaskinportenSchema
  with this id.
- `tag:kartverket.no,2026:method-not-allowed` (405): the endpoint at this path does not accept this HTTP method.
- `tag:kartverket.no,2026:upstream-error` (502): this API could not get a usable answer from Altinn, or from the
  service that says which resources and scopes the calling app has access to. Your request did not cause it.
- `tag:kartverket.no,2026:internal-error` (500): an unexpected error in this API.

title.description: A short name for the `type`, the same every time.

status.description: The HTTP status code, the same as the response's.

detail.description: What went wrong this time, for people to read. Left out when `title` says it all. The wording may change, so check `type` in your code.

errors.description: Only with `tag:kartverket.no,2026:validation-error`: every field that failed, so you can fix them all at once.

en.description: In English. Left out if missing.

nb.description: In Norwegian Bokmål. Left out if missing.

MaskinportenSchemaRequest.title: MaskinportenSchemaRequest
MaskinportenSchemaRequest.description: A whole MaskinportenSchema, to replace the one in Altinn. A field that is left out is removed, and the fields Altinn has that are not here are kept as they are. `status`, `delegable` and `visible` cannot be changed here, so leave them out, like any field not listed.

resourceId.description: Optional. If it is sent, it must be the id in the path.

scopes.description: Required. The Maskinporten scopes the resource is for, at least one. Altinn only accepts Kartverket's scopes.

homepage.description: Optional. A web page about the resource.

contactPoints.description: Optional. Where to get help with the resource.

keywords.description: Optional. Words to find the resource by in Altinn.
